profile.privacyText: Motivance will use your sign-in email, name, username, birthdate, gender, address, contact number and avatar to manage your account and support rehabilitation within this system. Your connected therapist can view these details to understand your patient profile and provide care. Your rehabilitation records are used for session tracking and progress review. We use these data only for these system purposes. You can edit your profile, request a copy or deletion of your data in Profile, and contact your care provider about your consent. Requests require review; they do not immediately erase existing care records. This agreement is separate from consent to record movement summaries. Privacy agreement version: system-purpose-v1.

agreement.title: Messages with your therapist
agreement.detail: Read what turning on messages means. You can turn them off at any time in Profile.
agreement.point1: Messages go only to the therapist you are linked with. Administrators and schedulers cannot read them.
agreement.point2: Messages are kept in your rehabilitation record. From Profile you can ask for a copy, or for them to be deleted.
agreement.point3: Your therapist does not read messages around the clock. For anything urgent, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital.
agreement.point4: If you turn messages off, nobody can send new ones. What was already said stays in your record, and your therapist can still read it.
agreement.profileDetail: Whether you and your therapist can write to each other here.
agreement.turnOffDetail: Nobody will be able to send new messages, you included. What was already said stays in your record, and your therapist can still read it. You can turn messages on again later.
agreement.point5: Photos and videos you send are made smaller on your device first. Motivance removes them 15 days after they are sent; a copy you saved yourself stays with you.
agreement.mediaDetail: You can now send photos and short videos. Read what that means before you allow it.
